title: Block impossible dates before recording corrective-action progress
prompt:
Fix calendar validation in lib/ohworks-corrective-action.ts. Lines 297-298 and 377-391 rely on a Z suffix and finite Date.parse result. I reproduced an accepted start_investigation event at nonexistent 2026-02-30T12:00:00Z: runCorrectiveActionWorkflow returned blocked=false, finalState=investigating, and preserved that timestamp in history. The request had matching synthetic tenant/record identifiers, a unique event ID, investigator demo role, and nonempty investigationScope. lib/ohworks-demo-capa-worksheet-view.ts:136 consumes this workflow to display corrective-action progress.

Validate literal UTC calendar and clock fields before duplicate detection, timestamp ordering, or transitions. Return the existing timestamp-invalid block for impossible dates while retaining timestamp-not-utc for otherwise valid non-UTC inputs. Keep valid leap-day and fractional-second timestamps supported. Preserve event identity, role checks, transition policy, and immutability. Do not modify the separate nonconformance module or add a shared utility.

Add tests/ohworks/corrective-action-event-calendar.test.ts exercising both applyCorrectiveActionEvent and runCorrectiveActionWorkflow. Cover the reproduction, an invalid later event after valid history, April 31, non-leap February 29, and valid leap-day controls. Assert the block code, unchanged state, blocked-event reporting, and exclusion of rejected events from history. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/corrective-action.test.ts tests/ohworks/corrective-action-event-calendar.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-capa-worksheet-view.test.ts.

Planning verification reproduced the defect and passed existing evaluator and demo-view tests. Change only this source and new test. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, auth, package.json, or workflow changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
